title: Inflation eased. Fuel did not.
gapNote: Seconds held after each voice line ends, before the next shot cuts.
orderNote: The film is not the page in order. The page runs column to split, one claim per section. The film opens on the flat line, opens the basket, follows the fuel, then the spread, then the uneven landing, and closes on the price level. One argument, six beats, in the order the argument needs.

endCard.title: Inflation eased. Fuel did not.
endCard.source: Data: Department of Statistics Malaysia, Consumer Price Index. CC BY 4.0.

shots.claim: The rate has not moved in three years.
shots.caption: Three years, and the line has not moved.
shots.beat: the surface. the calm number, before anything opens up.

shots.claim: Inside that number, the divisions pull in opposite directions.
shots.caption: Transport rose. Housing fell. The net barely moved.
shots.beat: the fracture. two shocks, opposite signs, one quiet total.

shots.claim: Fuel is the loud part, and the wedge is still open.
shots.caption: RON95 averaged RM4.18 against a subsidised RM2.05.
shots.beat: the cause. the one shock big enough to matter.

shots.caption: The cheapest state ran at 0.5%. The dearest at 2.4%.
shots.beat: the ground. the national number is an average of a spread.

shots.claim: The same shock, two different roads.
shots.caption: City transport 2.75%. Countryside 1.35%.
shots.beat: the person. the shock does not land evenly.

shots.caption: One year of that climb is 1.8%.
shots.beat: the landing. the level, and how small one year of it is.
